methodology.title: منهجية استخراج أسئلة الإجابة الحرة (Free Answer)
methodology.description: تم استخراج أسئلة الإجابة الحرة من مصادر الدرس (كتاب الطالب، كتاب النشاط) بناءً على الجمل العامة والمعلوماتية التي تتيح للطالب التعبير عن رأيه أو معرفته.
selection_criteria: السؤال عام ولا يحتاج إلى قراءة النص للإجابة عليه
الجواب مفتوح ويعتمد على معرفة الطالب أو رأيه الشخصي
تنويع المواضيع (القراءة، الطقس، الصحة، الزراعة، الكتب)
methodology.verification_method: البحث عن الكلمات المفتاحية في إجابة الطالب

questions.question: What kind of books do you like to read? Why?
questions.translation: ما نوع الكتب التي تحب قراءتها؟ ولماذا؟
suggested_answers: I like reading adventure books because they are exciting.
I like reading science books because they are interesting.
I like reading stories because they are fun.

questions.question: Why do you think fewer people read books nowadays?
questions.translation: لماذا تعتقد أن عدداً أقل من الناس يقرأ الكتب هذه الأيام؟
suggested_answers: Because they spend more time on phones and social media.
Because they are busy with work and life.
Because they prefer watching TV and playing video games.

questions.question: What book would you recommend to a friend? Why?
questions.translation: ما الكتاب الذي تنصح به صديقك؟ ولماذا؟
suggested_answers: I would recommend a story book because it is interesting.
I would recommend a science book because it is useful.
I would recommend an adventure book because it is exciting.

questions.question: What happens if you eat too much sugary food?
questions.translation: ماذا يحدث إذا تناولت الكثير من الأطعمة السكرية؟
suggested_answers: You may gain weight.
You may get health problems like diabetes.
It can affect your teeth.

questions.question: What do you do to stay healthy?
suggested_answers: I exercise every day.
I eat fruits and vegetables.
I drink water and sleep well.

questions.question: What do farmers plant in your country?
suggested_answers: Farmers plant wheat and corn.
Farmers plant olives and grapes.
Farmers plant vegetables like tomatoes and potatoes.

questions.question: What kind of weather do you prefer? Why?
questions.translation: ما نوع الطقس الذي تفضله؟ ولماذا؟
suggested_answers: I prefer sunny weather because I can play outside.
I prefer rainy weather because it's cool and relaxing.
I prefer mild weather because it is comfortable.
